blocks.text: The Ravenna® Collection from Classic Accessories combines convenient features with durable construction and handsome looks. Time spent with family and friends will be safe for years to come with covers from the Ravenna® Collection by Classic Accessories. When you buy a Classic Accessories grill or patio furniture cover you are not just getting a cover; you’re also purchasing peace of mind. Not only will your grill and patio furniture be protected from the elements, but you’ll be protected with the easiest warranty in the industry. If your product fails within the warranty period, look for us online and take advantage of our Hassle-Free warranty program supported by our US-based customer service team.

items.label: Main Body
items.value: 100% Woven Polyester With Laminated 6p-free & Eu Reach Compliant Polyvinyl Chloride Backing; Hem Casing: 100% Woven Polyester

items.label: HEAVY DUTY AND WATER RESISTANT
items.value: Gardelle One is a durable woven polyester fabric with an added UV-stabilized coating and a water-resistant laminated 6P Free and EU REACH compliant undercoating

items.label: CUSTOM FIT PATIO COVER
items.value: Patented WindLock secure attachment system includes an adjustable belted hem with click-close straps that provides a customizable fit with exceptional security in the windiest conditions

items.label: DURABLE COVER WITH ADVANCED FEATURES
items.value: Reinforced padded handles make removal easy while air vents keep weather out providing maximum ventilation and minimum condensation
